crossRefs.note: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves…
This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under…
This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under…
The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry…

parallels.note: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of…
Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service, and for all that will be done therein.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
translations.bsb: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
translations.asv: And they shall keep all the furniture of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
